Starting 10 years late costs you ₹2.3 crore.

₹5,000 a month from age 25 to 60, at 12%: about ₹3.2 crore. Start at 35 instead: about ₹95 lakh. Same ₹5,000. Ten years late, ₹2.3 crore less. Lesson: time matters more than amount.

Inflation, explained simply 📊

Your 100 rupees is shrinking every year. That's inflation. If prices rise 6% a year, what costs 100 today costs 106 next year. Same note. Less stuff. Your money must grow faster than prices.

Why Prices End In 99 🧠

Why does everything cost 499, not 500? Your brain reads the first digit first. 4 feels much cheaper than 5. It's called the left-digit effect. One rupee changes how big the price feels. So round it up in your head before you decide.

Real return 📊

Your FD gave 7%. You may have earned almost nothing. Real return is your return minus inflation. 7% return, 6% inflation. Real return is about 1%. Then tax takes a bite too. Always ask: what's left after inflation?

How Zepto Makes Money 💰

Groceries in 10 minutes. But Zepto lost 3,367 crore rupees in one year. The trick is the dark store. A small warehouse near your home, with riders already waiting. It earns commission from brands, ads inside the app, and small fees on your order. Sales hit 9,668 crore rupees in FY25, more than double. But losses grew even faster. The bet: grow huge first, and make profit at scale later. Speed sells. Scale costs. Profit waits.

CAGR 📊

Doubled your money? That's not the full story. CAGR is your average yearly growth rate. Doubling in 3 years is about 26% a year. Doubling in 12 years is only about 6%. Time changes everything.
